meta.name: init-xcode-app
meta.description: Scaffold a standalone SwiftUI app via XcodeGen — pick macOS, iOS, or iOS+watchOS; ships house conventions, a Swift Testing target, swiftformat/swiftlint, optional CloudKit/CI/Release/Push modules, and optional JTBD product context. Use to "init an xcode project", "scaffold a swiftui app", "new mac/ios app".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速搭建带代码规范的SwiftUI项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚想创建一个完整配置的SwiftUI项目
copy.tagline_en: Quickly scaffold a SwiftUI project with code conventions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to set up a SwiftUI project with linting and testing from scratch

howto.what: 根据用户选择的平台（macOS、iOS 或 iOS+watchOS），自动生成一个完整的 SwiftUI Xcode 项目，包含项目配置、代码模板、格式化工具、可选模块（CloudKit、CI、Release、Push）和可选的产品上下文文档。
howto.when: 当你说“init an xcode project”、“scaffold a swiftui app”或“new mac/ios app”，或者要求创建一个新的 Xcode 项目时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个名为Tidepool的iOS SwiftUI应用。
say.note: Claude 会询问配置选项并生成项目。
Claude 会生成 macOS 版本的项目。

howto.what_en: Scaffolds a complete SwiftUI Xcode project based on the chosen platform (macOS, iOS, or iOS+watchOS), including project config, code templates, formatting tools, optional modules (CloudKit, CI, Release, Push), and optional JTBD product context documents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'init an xcode project', 'scaffold a swiftui app', 'new mac/ios app', or ask to create a new Xcode project.

say_en.text: Create an iOS SwiftUI app named Tidepool.
say_en.note: Claude will ask configuration options and generate the project.

say_en.text: Scaffold a macOS project called DailyBoard with XcodeGen.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the macOS version.

say_en.text: Init my new app with CloudKit and CI.
say_en.note: Claude will include the selected modules.
